meaning:
1) deceitful, sly, insidious
1a) deceitful, sly, insidious, slippery
1b) foot-tracked

elsewhere.note: Every valley shall be exalted, and every mountain and hill shall be made low. The uneven shall be made level, and the rough places a plain.
The heart is deceitful above all things and it is exceedingly corrupt. Who can know it?
Gilead is a city of those who work iniquity; it is stained with blood.
